comparison: Compare the adapter's unrounded value with the decimal interval implied by the printed precision: expected +/- one half of the final printed unit; strict interior is a match, exact endpoints are rounding-convention-ambiguous, outside is a discrepancy

diagnostic_scope: Only these two controls; same expectations and paper alignment parameters, threads1; compare official macOS x86_64 BLAST2.9 binary running successfully on this host with the previous native2.17 run. No full97 rerun or threshold changes.
